Background

Data

Raw data from Schaefer et al. downloaded from the EDI data portal


Binding the four raw data frames


Methods

Filtering for sample date and 5 ions: Pottassium, Nitrate, Calcium, Magenesium, and Ammonium.



Function was created to run the code that assigns 9 week windows and calculates the mean concentration for each ion.



The output of this code returns a wide tibble. This code converts the table to long tidy form.



Results

Each graph shows the results of the 9 week moving average analysis of ions sampled at four sites before and after Hurricane Hugo
Colors represent differnt sites
